domain_setting: A calm portrait studio, salon, and wardrobe space for describing hair, eyes, skin, age, height, build, and personal style.
recurring_scale_anchors: Use a consistent adult portrait scale for hair, eye-color, and skin descriptors so the pictured trait is easy to compare.
Keep faces warm and varied in skin tone, facial features, and gender presentation without making attractiveness or age judgments caricatural.
Use safe neutral editorial styling; no written labels, numbers, logos, or beauty rankings.
Hair and eye colors should remain distinguishable in a thumbnail while keeping natural color families.

polysemy_resolution_table.mole: A small pigmented skin mark beside the cheek; the facial-skin group overrides the unrelated Japanese animal gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.short: A short person, following the height-and-build group, rather than a short length or duration.
polysemy_resolution_table.appearance: A person's overall visible look in a portrait, matching the appearance section rather than the verb ‘appear’ alone.
polysemy_resolution_table.smart: Neatly stylish and well put together, following the appearance-and-clothing group despite the intelligence gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.hair cut: The haircut as a result or style; the two verb phrases show a person receiving a haircut in a salon.
polysemy_resolution_table.get your hair cut / have your hair cut: Near-synonyms shown as haircut actions, but with different moments in the salon interaction.
polysemy_resolution_table.facial hair: A broad overview of hair on the chin, jaw, and upper lip; beard, goatee, mustache, sideburns, and stubble stay visibly specific.
polysemy_resolution_table.olive skin: A natural warm medium complexion with muted golden-olive undertones, not green-colored skin.
polysemy_resolution_table.pale skin: Very light, cool-toned skin shown gently, without implying sickness or distress.

contrast_notes.hair descriptors: Keep hair silhouette/texture cues consistent while varying only the target feature: color, curl, frizz, length, ponytail, or baldness.
contrast_notes.curly hair / frizzy hair: Curls form defined loops; frizzy hair forms many fine loose flyaways and an irregular halo.
contrast_notes.long / shoulder-length / short hair: Use clear shoulder landmarks and distinct hair endpoints on the same portrait scale.
contrast_notes.beard / goatee / mustache / sideburns /: Place the target growth only in its defining facial region and vary density from coarse beard to fine stubble.
contrast_notes.eye colors: Render the same readable iris shape with blue, brown, gray, green, or mixed hazel tones; avoid relying on tiny differences alone.
contrast_notes.skin descriptors: Use side-by-side complexion swatches or consistently framed portraits so fair, pale, olive, tan, and dark are not conflated.
contrast_notes.average height / medium height / short /: Use measured side-by-side people to clarify relative scale; center the target height between references where useful.
contrast_notes.casual / formal / elegant / glamorous /: Differentiate everyday relaxed clothing, ceremonial tailoring, graceful minimal lines, evening sparkle, and polished smart-casual tailoring.
contrast_notes.beautiful / handsome / glamorous: Use distinct respectful portrait or event contexts without implying that one appearance is objectively superior.
